findings.why: AC-STORY-02-02-3 tests only the append-level normalization path: append already writes the NFC key, so removing normalize_key from snapshot() leaves all tests green and FR-9(b)'s snapshot-level normalization is never exercised.
snapshot() swallows FileNotFoundError to return {} while verify() raises; behavior is reasonable but untested and inconsistent with sibling read paths.
else-branch treats any non-delete op as a put, so a malformed line with unknown/missing op silently yields state[key]=None; unreachable via append but a cheap guard.
